serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Wickr for Government (WickrGov) information system Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), provides the necessary all-in-one collaboration platform for encrypted messaging, audio/video calling, screen sharing, chat rooms and file sharing, all while ensuring communications are completely protected by advanced security protocols. In addition, WickrGov offers data retention capabilities for regulated industries. WickrGov provides multiple levels of administrative security controls and standard IT integrations with directory services and end-user authentication features. The WickrGov application is hosted and provided to U.S. Federal agencies, including local and state governments and tribal organizations, and Commercial organizations.
